- short infra Q&A with customer engineering (network/VPC/egress)
- security lead to confirm data handling and audit logs

1) Tue 24 Aug, 15:30–16:30 BST (14:30–15:30 UTC)
2) Wed 25 Aug, 16:00–17:00 BST (15:00–16:00 UTC)

Can SE confirm which slot they can cover (we may need an SE + engineer pair), and can the AE (Aditya) confirm procurement point-of-contact so we can get the NDA/procurement step moving? I attached a first-pass mutual action plan to speed approvals.

Proposed agenda (compact):
- 5m intros + objective
- 25m live demo (SE)
- 15m infra & network/security Q&A (customer eng + security)
- 10m next steps / procurement + runbook handoff

Thanks — if neither slot works we need to propose alternatives quickly; NebulaAcme indicated these are the only slots their security lead can make.

- Our infrastructure engineer (me) can join either slot but prefers the 25 Aug slot to avoid overlap with an internal migration.
- Procurement (procurement@nebulaacme.com) needs the signed mutual action plan + a short SOW (1 page) before issuing purchase order; they have a DocuSign powerform but asked for the MAP to be attached first.

We’ve attached a filled security questionnaire with a few answers already populated — you'll see notes where our security lead wants a pre-shared network diagram or redacted logs for context. We can share a recording/diagram ahead of time if that helps with the audit trail.

Preferred: Wed 25 Aug, 16:00–17:00 BST (15:00–16:00 UTC) — that gives our infra engineer and security lead the overlap they need. If you can confirm, we’ll accept the calendar invite and have procurement start the paperwork.
